verdict.rationale: Airwallex markets its corporate cards with '2% Cashback, Spend Controls & No FX Fees' on its business account cards page, implying automatic cashback tied to card spend, but there is no documentation describing the mechanics (e.g., automatic accrual, no redemption steps, eligibility, caps) that would confirm the 'no manual redemption' claim. missing for 10: technical/program documentation on cashback accrual and redemption process, confirmation that it is automatic with zero manual steps, independent user corroboration.
